plan.hypothesis: After the first rate-anomalous jump, persistent zero wheels can pass the ordinary innovation gate even while the model still moves. Reject a fresh agreeing zero pair while predicted speed exceeds stop_model_speed_mps; preserve raw adaptation and normal actual-stop logic.
plan.selection: Same gates as decay: >=2% clean OR >=5% fault gain relative to v5, <=1% aggregate regression, per-bag max(0.01m/s,10%), no coverage/false-stop/recovery loss, scalar group macro regression <=0.5%.
plan.risk: Real stopping may be delayed when model speed remains biased above 0.25m/s. Full clean validation and distance metrics must assess that risk; do not tune the stop threshold after evaluation.
plan.data_policy: Fixed validation selection only; both receivers retained; no final test IO. Two predefined candidates, including one combination with previously non-regressing process noise x2.
